fonio.ai is a market leader in AI agents for SMBs. We started with phone agents and now also cover WhatsApp, web chat, email and a full AI phone system. We're growing fast across Europe, the UK, the US and Brazil.

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months, then went from $10M to $20M in about 8 weeks. Today we serve 10,000+ customers.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of the fastest-growing companies! ¿ 1 Global Mobility & Onboarding Specialist (f/m/d) Your Role

You make every new fonio teammate feel at home from day one. You own the journey from signed offer to fully ramped, and help international colleagues relocate across countries, from Spain and Austria to the UK, the US, Poland and beyond.

 * Onboarding experience: Build the fonio way of joining: pre-boarding, day one, first 90 days. Welcome kits, buddies, team playbooks. Automate it so it scales with our hiring.

 * Go-to person: Act as the primary point of contact for every new joiner. Answer fast, solve issues, and run onboarding sessions on our tools and ways of working.

 * Stakeholder Management: Become the sparring partner with Department Leads in order to build engaging and interactive sessions. Make it fun!

 * Ready on day one: Align with People Ops, IT and hiring managers so access, equipment and paperwork are complete before day one.

 * Progress & accuracy: Monitor every onboarding, track completion and follow up on open items. Keep documentation, employee records and system access accurate and up to date.

 * Compliance: Make sure every onboarding and relocation meets internal policies, data protection (GDPR) and local labor and immigration rules.

 * Relocation & global mobility: Run international relocations end-to-end in every country we hire in: visas and work permits, residence and local registrations, Social Security enrollment, bank accounts, housing. Build country playbooks and manage relocation and immigration partners.

 * Expat taxation: Guide new joiners on tax residency, double taxation, social security coordination and local expat tax regimes, together with external advisors.

 * Feedback loop: Spot bottlenecks. Measure how new joiners feel and how fast they ramp. Keep improving.

What to Expect

 * Solo, end-to-end ownership of how people join fonio.

 * Close collaboration with People Ops, hiring managers and the founders.

 * Direct impact: you shape everyone's first impression of fonio.

What You Bring

 * 3+ years in onboarding, employee experience or global mobility, ideally startup or scale-up.

 * Hands-on experience relocating employees across multiple countries (EU and non-EU).

 * Know-how in international immigration (EU, UK, US) and expat taxation.

 * An eye for experience and brand.

 * AI and automation/workflow skills.

 * People-first, low ego. You thrive under intensity.

 * Strong English skills; German is a strong plus.

 

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €80,000

 * Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Barcelona, working directly with the core-team

When you go the extra mile

 * Dinner on us when you stay late

 * Ride home covered when you work past late hours

Hiring Process

 * 20 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture call

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is. Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

Lam Research Salzburg GmbH - The group you'll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's panel products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor / advanced packaging industry. 1 Process Support Engineer (all genders) Job-ID: 203511 I Work Location Model: On-site I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

The impact you'll make

As a Process Support Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.

What you'll do

 * Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam's cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems

 * Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements

 * Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications

 * Develop robust simulations to support process result understanding and suggesting next reasonable process steps to improve the performance

 * Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications

 * Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap

Who we're looking for

Minimum qualifications

 * Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 3+ years of experience; or a PhD with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience in electrochemical metal surface deposition and/or modification

 * Highly proficient in Python, COMSOL, Ansys, or other similar scientific computing language

 * Creating/developing models to support obtained process results, e.g. current distribution maps

 * Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies

 * Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.) as well as knowledge of material analysis techniques

 * Ability to work independently, high degree of flexibility and capable to work in a cross functional environment

 * Structured and organized working style

 * Good English oral and written communication skills

Preferred qualifications

 * Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

 * Background in electrochemistry, in particular electrochemical metal deposition

 * Safe work with chemicals

 * Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization

 * Understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE)

 * Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners

What we're offering
